summary: Narrow university campus road bend, steep, with no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Campus lab and glasshouse buildings line both sides, 3-17 m away, though none are homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Road is a narrow bend with building walls and path edges beside it; no clear ground to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Campus service road next to the multi-level car parks.
drivers.convention: Only a couple of cars at the road edge to the north-east; no overnight parking convention.

flags: Works compound and crane on the QLD image, older than the Esri one
sun_shade: Open to sky; nearby buildings shade parts of the road in the morning and afternoon.
